diff --git a/web/src/components/ViimeApp.vue b/web/src/components/ViimeApp.vue
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..9f4915770
--- /dev/null
+++ b/web/src/components/ViimeApp.vue
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+<template lang="pug">
+v-app
+  v-toolbar.darken-3(dense, dark, color="primary")
+    v-toolbar-side-icon.logo(@click="$router.push('/')") V
+    v-breadcrumbs(:items="breadcrumbs", divider="»")
+      template(#item="props")
+        v-breadcrumbs-item(:to="props.item.to", exact) {{props.item.text}}
+  v-container.pa-0.d-flex(fluid)
+    router-view.grow
+</template>
+
+<script>
+
+export default {
+  name: 'App',
+  computed: {
+    breadcrumbs() {
+      return [
+        {
+          text: 'VIIME',
+          to: { name: 'Root' },
+        },
+        ...this.$route.matched.map((route) => {
+          const b = route.meta.breadcrumb;
+          return {
+            text: route.name,
+            to: { name: route.name, params: this.$route.params },
+            ...(b ? b.call(route, this.$route.params, this.$store) : {}),
+          };
+        }),
+      ];
+    },
+  },
+};
+</script>
+
+<style lang="scss">
+.viime-app {
+  .logo.v-btn--icon {
+    font-size: 150%;
+  }
+
+  .v-breadcrumbs li {
+    font-size: 20px;
+
+    > a {
+      color: inherit
+    }
+  }
+  .grow-overflow {
+    flex: 1 1 0;
+    overflow: auto;
+    max-height: 100%;
+  }
+}
+</style>

+.scroll-down {

+  left: 75px;
+  line-height: 1.1em;
+  position: absolute;
+  .scroll-down-wrap {

+    width: 15px;
+    span {
+      animation: animate 2.2s infinite;
+      border-bottom: 2px solid #fff;
+      border-right: 2px solid #fff;
+      display: block;
+      height: 10px;
+      margin: -10px;
+      transform: rotate(45deg);
+      width: 10px;
+    }
+
+    span:nth-child(2) {
+      animation-delay: -0.2s;
+    }
+
+    span:nth-child(3) {

+  80% {
